keywords_rule: One keyword per line. Keywords of 6 or more letters match anywhere in a job title, so “planner” finds “Transportplanner”. Shorter ones must start a word, so “rail” finds “Rail Planner” and skips “Retail”. Changes are saved in this browser only.
keywords_air_ocean: Air and ocean words (hidden unless the title also names road, rail or intermodal)
